An engineer is a practitioner of engineering . [ 1 ] [ 2 ] The word engineer ( Latin ingeniator , [ 3 ] Ir is the term and or title of an engineer in countries like Belgium, The Netherlands, and Indonesia) is derived from the Latin words ingeniare ("to contrive, devise") and ingenium ("cleverness"). [ 4 ] [ 5 ] The foundational qualifications of a licensed professional engineer typically include a four-year bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline , or in some jurisdictions, a master's degree in an engineering discipline plus four to six years of peer-reviewed professional practice (culminating in a project report or thesis) and passage of engineering board examinations.
